limitations: Retained HN type bound rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_hn_type_bounds.
Finite-type semistable substack rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_semistable_substacks.
Quasi-smooth derived enhancement rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_derived_enhancements.
Scalar rigidification and finite residual inertia rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_rigidification_inertia.
Finite class set, Hilbert-polynomial, amplitude, and regularity-bound rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_class_bounds.
Universal perfect complex rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_universal_complexes.
E-translation rigidification rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_e_translation_rigidifications.
Retained closed-substack and finite closed-cover rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_closed_substacks.
Retained extension-closure rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_extension_closure.
Retained HN-factor-closure rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_hn_factor_closure.
Retained dual-closure rows are supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_dual_closure.
Extension-stack and two-step flag-stack rows are not supplied by the extension-closure rows.
Subquotient closure in compactified flag stacks is not supplied by the dual-closure rows.
Finite-moduli transition geometry is tracked separately by certificates/moduli/finite_moduli_transition_geometry; no proper-or-closed transition rows are supplied.
Moduli cohomology R1lim vanishing is tracked separately by certificates/moduli/moduli_cohomology_lim1_vanishing; no cohomology tower or image-stabilization rows are supplied.
No extension or flag stack rows are supplied.
No d-critical cosection atlas rows are supplied.
No strict transition or Mittag-Leffler rows are supplied.
No scalar-firewall rows excluding charge-window, Liu-stability-only, Hilbert-scheme-scalar, target-window, or Pfaffian-product substitutes are supplied.
